description: This Java class defines a Presentation used in an Android application to facilitate interaction between primary and secondary screens. It displays display information and allows setting background color and displaying that color as text.

classes.name: SamplePresentation
classes.description: A custom Presentation class used to display display info and change background color in an Android secondary screen environment.

methods.name: SamplePresentation
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the presentation with a context and display.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Lifecycle method that sets the layout, initializes views, and displays the display name.

methods.name: setColor
methods.description: Sets the background color of the layout and updates the display text to show the color value.
